description: Samoa's Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment runs a set of public dashboards, and the waste management one maps how rubbish is collected and records what beach and street cleanups find. It shows six waste collection routes and 33 collection zones as map layers with a zone schedule, and a table of cleanup audit records giving the zone, event, waste category code, number of items and weight, with charts of weight by category and items by zone. When read it summarised 1,375 items weighing 42 kg across three cleanup zones and 22 categories, largely from cleanups around the 2024 Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting. The data are free to view and available to download as CSV or PDF from the dashboard. Caveats: the cleanup sample is small and event-based, it says nothing about collected tonnage or landfill volumes, the page is part of a project portfolio portal, and no licence is stated. Coverage is the zones mapped by the ministry in Samoa. Simulation uses: collection zone and route geometry for waste collection routing studies on a small island. Related records: the Jamaica NSWMA waste characterisation studies (data-nswma-jamaica-waste-characterisation-studies) give comparable island waste composition data.
